assertions.summary: All three protected password hashes are nonempty, unlocked, algorithm 6, and their non-secret SHA-256 digests match between source and destination.

evidence.command:
printf 'NODE|%s
' "$NODE_NAME"; today=$(($(date +%s) / 86400)); rc=0; for u in mira niko sana; do h=$(sudo -n awk -F: -v u="$u" '$1 == u {print $2; found=1} END {if (!found) exit 4}' /etc/shadow); hr=$?; if [ "$hr" -ne 0 ]; then printf 'SHADOW|%s|protected_read=failed|rc=%s
' "$u" "$hr"; rc=1; continue; fi; if printf '%s
' "$h" | sha256sum >/tmp/infraset-shadow-digest.$$ 2>/dev/null; then digest=$(awk '{print $1}' /tmp/infraset-shadow-digest.$$); else printf 'SHADOW|%s|digest=unavailable
' "$u"; rc=1; continue; fi; alg=legacy; case "$h" in \$*) alg=$(printf '%s
' "$h" | awk -F'$' '{print $2}');; esac; nonempty=no; [ -n "$h" ] && nonempty=yes; unlocked=yes; case "$h" in ""|"!"*|"*"*) unlocked=no;; esac; printf 'SHADOW|%s|hash_digest=%s|algorithm=%s|nonempty=%s|unlocked=%s
' "$u" "$digest" "$alg" "$nonempty" "$unlocked"; done; rm -f /tmp/infraset-shadow-digest.$$; exit "$rc"
